builder.note: not found. A search-engine summary again claimed Multiplex was appointed for a '20MW stage 1', but no fetched page (NEXTDC releases, EstimateOne, Urban Developer, Architectus, Baxtel) names a builder; EstimateOne stage 1 trade tenders closed 28 Aug 2026 with builder not shown. mw_it.note: 162MW per NEXTDC approval release (19 Jan 2026) and Urban Developer; NEXTDC's June 2025 release, current M4 site page (150MW IT, 26,400 m2 technical space, 'In Planning'), Architectus and Mingtiandi say 150MW

cost_aud_m.note: campus-level A$2bn per NEXTDC releases (June 2025, Jan 2026) and Premier's release; Mingtiandi's $1.3B is the USD conversion. The Jan 2025 application was reported as a '$200-million data centre' (Urban Developer, source 10); SMH (via source 12) described a NEXTDC Port Melbourne facility 'costing nearly $1 billion' approved in 75 days; EstimateOne gives stage 1 budget >$200m

lodged.note: Urban Developer 10 Jan 2025 reported the $200m M4 plans (filed document); later articles say 'plans made public in January 2025'. Exact register lodgement date not checked (register blocked)

determined.note: Middle.news (fetched): permit from the Victorian Minister for Planning announced 16 Jan 2026; NEXTDC release dated 19 Jan 2026

jobs_construction.note: NEXTDC, Premier (12 Jun 2025) and Urban Developer say M4 will 'support thousands of high-value jobs' / 'create thousands of jobs' - no construction or operational figure

construction_start.note: FY26 results (master.csv; Listcorp page 403 so not re-checked): early works progressing; EstimateOne stage 1 trade tenders closed 28 Aug 2026; NEXTDC site page still says 'In Planning'

construction_end.note: no date from operator; Baxtel (aggregator) says 'Site planned for 2027 and has expansions through 2029'
